cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(super_planner)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(PCL REQUIRED COMPONENTS common io filters kdtree)
find_package(yaml-cpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nav_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(visualization_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(tf2_ros REQUIRED)
find_package(pcl_conversions REQUIRED)
find_package(rog_map REQUIRED)
file(GLOB_RECURSE sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp)
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/(fsm|waypoint_trajectory_optimizer).cpp$")
add_library(easyfly_super_planner SHARED ${sources})
target_link_options(easyfly_super_planner PRIVATE -Wl,--no-undefined)
target_include_directories(easyfly_super_planner PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_compile_definitions(easyfly_super_planner PUBLIC USE_ROS2 ORIGIN_AT_CORNER FMT_HEADER_ONLY ROOT_DIR="")
target_compile_options(easyfly_super_planner PRIVATE -O2 -Werror=return-type)
ament_target_dependencies(easyfly_super_planner PUBLIC rclcpp std_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs visualization_msgs tf2_ros pcl_conversions)
target_link_libraries(easyfly_super_planner PUBLIC Eigen3::Eigen yaml-cpp ${PCL_LIBRARIES} rog_map::easyfly_rog_map)
install(TARGETS easyfly_super_planner EXPORT super_plannerTargets LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
install(FILES NOTICE.md UPSTREAM-README.md COPYING COPYING.LESSER DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_export_targets(super_plannerTargets HAS_LIBRARY_TARGET NAMESPACE super_planner::)
ament_export_dependencies(Eigen3 PCL yaml-cpp rclcpp std_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs visualization_msgs tf2_ros pcl_conversions rog_map)
ament_package()
